CRUSH 3.0.0 - from-scratch compressor (Windows x64)
Farica☆Kimora © Cursed Entertainment - https://cursedprograms.github.io/CRUSH/

  crush a out.crush file_or_folder ...   create (folders are added with everything in them)
  crush x out.crush [dest]               extract (to dest, or the current folder)
  crush e out.crush                      extract to a folder named after the archive
  crush l out.crush                      list + ratios
  crush t out.crush                      test integrity (CRC32 of every file)

In Explorer (if you installed with the right-click option):
  right-click a file or folder   -> Add to CRUSH archive
  right-click a .crush file      -> Extract to folder / Test archive
  double-click a .crush file     -> list what's in it

Reads archives from CRUSH 2 too. Standalone: no runtime DLLs needed.
Source and build instructions: https://github.com/CursedPrograms/CRUSH
